fields.label: Detect
fields.name: detect_mode
fields.tooltip: What the primary selection targets. body → RT-DETR person boxes refined by SAM3; face/hands → SAM3 open-vocabulary text selection.

fields.label: Detection threshold
fields.name: detection_threshold
fields.tooltip: RT-DETR box confidence. Lower catches more instances, noisier boxes.

fields.label: SAM3 threshold
fields.name: sam_threshold
fields.tooltip: SAM3 mask confidence.

fields.label: Dilation (px)
fields.name: sam_dilation
fields.tooltip: Grow the final mask N pixels — the inpaint bleed margin.

fields.label: Output
fields.name: output_mode
fields.tooltip: segm saves masks; bbox saves the drawn-box manifest preview.

fields.label: Instance filter
fields.name: instance_filter
fields.tooltip: 'all' | 'largest' | comma indices '0,2' — which detected instances the primary keeps.

fields.label: Max instances
fields.name: max_instances
fields.tooltip: Cap detected instances (0 = no cap). Read the manifest first, then filter.

fields.label: SAM3 prompt
fields.name: sam3_prompt
fields.tooltip: Open-vocabulary text selection — e.g. 'the red hat', 'left shoe'. Rides INSTEAD of detect_mode when set.

fields.label: Export box manifest
fields.name: export_boxes
fields.tooltip: Draw RT-DETR boxes on the image — the instance manifest (read it, then set instance_filter).

fields.label: Export paint mask
fields.name: export_paint
fields.tooltip: ON when a brush stroke exists — the painted payload becomes its own mask export.

fields.label: Scope ROI
fields.name: roi
fields.tooltip: [x, y, w, h] fractions — run-global crop of every selection. Recipe filters may carry their own; identical scopes only.

fields.label: Recipe (outputs)
fields.name: outputs
fields.tooltip: THE recipe form: one entry per mask, filter (where) over selection (how). Non-empty ⇒ overrides the flat params. See AGENT.md.

fields.label: Input image
fields.name: input_image
fields.tooltip: The photo to select from — absolute path or an artifact ref from a prior run.
